# Upstream source

This directory contains the read-only WeChat 4.x database module adapted from:

- Project: https://github.com/fanyuantaier/wechatauto-replica
- Upstream commit: `b9a9f5619f34c6a3e6eb15c27ec73d0adbbb4386`
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

Only `wechatauto/db.py` is loaded by this project. The upstream UI automation,
media, Moments, and sending modules are not included in the tracked vendor set.
